title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/components/[entity]
responsibility: Shows one component at a branch tip or a selected commit: its contract, size, performance and what proves it.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The markup this route renders for every URL it matches: a HarnessScreen titled Component whose content is EntityVisualScreen, which draws the entity's frame and sections and, outside the components category, its screens and audio. The page reads no route parameters or data itself, so HarnessConsole places the view from the URL path and query that HarnessScreen passes to it.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: The document title that HarnessScreen sets to the title this page passes, Component, followed by · Harness. Nothing in this file varies it, so it does not change with the branch, commit or entity.
